Remark
[intrinsic versus extrinsic geometry]

Source: petersen:page-0115 ↗ ex:pet-ch3-zero-shape-operator-hyperplane

The curvature tensor depends only on $(M,g)$, whereas the shape operator also depends on a chosen isometric immersion $(M,g)\to (\bar M,\bar g)$.
